ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes, bordered by a thin, irregular low-intensity black band along the trailing edge. A single localized low-intensity circular focal spot is visible in the mid-right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration along the entire trailing edge, with pixel-amplitude peaks of 5-15 units, becoming more pronounced and jagged toward the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature from the central leading edge baseline sweeping outward and upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible high-contrast clusters of circular yellowish-white objects localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized dark circular mark in the center-right white field; heavy barnacle colonization on lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high degree of white pigmentation covering nearly the entire visible ventral fluke area.
